drafts.label: Short · nobody taught decision-making
drafts.body:
Nobody really hands you a class called decision-making.

You get subjects. You get marks. Somewhere in the middle you're supposed to invent judgment.

Faster answers make that gap louder, not smaller. If schools won't teach the skill, practice it on purpose — small choices, spoken reasons, one check: would I still pick this if the chat said the opposite?
drafts.why: Independent values/education pillar — decision-making as missing core skill; not mashup of five-minute amnesia or Qwen rev-share.

quality.notes: Independent insight: decision-making never taught as a subject; practice with opposite-of-chat check. Bookmark for students/teachers; soul + practice; not pack collage.
